metadata.description: Build HTML dashboards, KPI reports and 16:9 slide decks from any data — powered by a zero-dependency SVG chart library.

plugins.name: chart-dashboard
plugins.description: Turn any data — a table, CSV, pasted numbers, metrics, or notes — into a self-contained HTML dashboard, illustrated report or slide deck with interactive SVG charts. Picks the right chart type for your data automatically. No CDN, no build step, no runtime dependencies, works offline.
